review_comment: The regulation says requirements must be met 'სესხის დამტკიცების მომენტში ... არსებული ინფორმაციის მიხედვით', and I found no clause in the policy on the point in time at which information is assessed. The proposal copies the regulatory text, which says 'ამ დებულებით' (this Order), so it is not adapted to a bank policy; the heading 3.6 is a guess.

review_unsupported_claims: The regulation_text field carries two versions of art3/p7 (2020 and a later one with 'საყურადღებო მოდიფიკაცია'), and the obligation drops the first half ('გაცემული სესხით ... დაიფაროს'). The rationale and missing say the policy has no 'ჯამური ვალდებულებების მოცულობის ზრდა' limit, which matches my search.
review_comment: The policy has no rule that refinancing or restructuring must not increase total obligations; §3.4 only covers re-assessment of PTI. The gold label is about extending the re-assessment to significantly modified loans, which the system did not raise; the proposal adds 'საყურადღებო მოდიფიკაცია' but is placed as a new 3.1, which clashes with the existing numbering.

§4.1 says 'PTI და LTV ზღვრული მაჩვენებლები განისაზღვრება დებულების დანართებით' but only by reference, and the policy has no Annex 2 limit rule or ban on issuing above the LTV limit, so 'none' on the LTV ban is defensible (at most partial given §4.1). The gold label concerns the §4.1 exception allowing PTI to exceed the limit by 10 percentage points, which this finding does not address.

The policy is for retail loans (§1.3) and has no clause limiting combined payments of business and non-business loans to 'დანართი №1-ით განსაზღვრულ სესხის მომსახურების კოეფიციენტს'. §2.3 defines PTI over total monthly obligations but sets no such cap, so 'none' is acceptable. The proposal repeats the regulation verbatim.

Nothing in the policy deals with loans for buying, building or renovating property 'გაქირავების მიზნით' or with the 'ნარჩენ თანხაზე' rule. The finding stands, although the duty is mainly for the borrower and the proposal is a verbatim copy.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation turns 'გამოიყენოს ... და, გონივრულობის ფარგლებში, განსაზღვროს' into a plain duty to use market averages. This is acceptable as it applies only when no data-based model is used (art6/p4 lead-in), a condition the obligation omits.
review_comment: §5.1 and §5.2 deal with income proof, and §5.2 lets a declaration alone suffice for consumer loans up to 10 000 GEL, while 'ბაზარზე ... საშუალო შემოსავლები, მომგებიანობის მაჩვენებლები' appear nowhere. The duty applies only in the no-model route, so the document has some income assessment but not this element, making 'partial' fairer than 'none'; the proposal drops the condition for this route.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation reduces the definition of 'რესტრუქტურიზებული სესხი' to the last sentence about financial-difficulty rules, dropping the definition itself (NBG risk-category/ECL rule or terms changed because of financial difficulty). The rationale says §3.4 'partially' meets the requirement, but §3.4 deals with PTI re-assessment, not with how financial difficulty is assessed. The proposal puts a made-up duty into §3.4.
review_comment: §2.2 defines restructured loans by the 2017 'აქტივების კლასიფიკაციის წესი' (№117/04) and not the ECL rule, so the definition in the policy is outdated against 'ფინანსური ინსტრუმენტების რისკის კატეგორიებისა და მოსალოდნელი საკრედიტო ზარალის განსაზღვრის წესი'. §2.2 also states 'სხვა სახის მოდიფიცირებულ სესხებს არ განსაზღვრავს', which is the gap the gold label (D12-02) points to; the system's 'partial' on financial-difficulty rules misses it.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the policy sets a 'stricter' 15-year term than the regulation's 20 years and that 15 'შეესაბამება' the 20-year limit. This is wrong: the Annex 1 row on FX mortgages with different-currency income (15 years) is a case ruled by art3/p6/sა.ბ, whose cap is 10 years. The finding compares it with the wrong sub-item (sა.ა, the 20-year rule). The proposed 20-year row for Lari mortgages invents a limit and a 'PTI' condition in the table.
review_comment: The policy has no row for Lari mortgages or same-currency FX mortgages up to '20 (ოცი) წელი', so that element is missing, and the Annex 1 row ('15 წელი') for FX mortgages with different-currency income and the row for real-estate-secured consumer loans ('15 წელი') exceed the 10-year caps in sა.ბ/sბ. The system treated the 15-year row as compliant when gold D12-14/15 says it is a breach, and its proposal keeps the 15-year consumer row, so it leaves the main violation in place.
